spec.algorithm: Seed commitment: SHA-256(server_seed). The first client_seed the game receives for an egg is locked on it. Stream: block(i)=HMAC-SHA256(server_seed, "shards-roll-v1|"+egg_id+"|"+client_seed+"|"+i) with i in decimal; words are consecutive 8-byte big-endian values of block(0)||block(1)||...; Uint64n(n) takes the next word w, skips it if w >= 2^64-(2^64 mod n), else returns w mod n. Hatch: if the player's pity target is of the egg's rarity and pity_counter+1 >= the receipt's pity_threshold the species is the target. Otherwise rarity = the tier whose cumulative units exceed Uint64n(total) in table[egg], then species = species[rarity][Uint64n(len)]. Then, for each name in stat_names in order, the stat is low + Uint64n(high-low+1) with [low, high] = stat_range[rarity] (just low when high <= low). Affinity and personality are rolled privately and are not part of the stream.
